bphs-97:santhanam:ch24:v98.context_before: If Dharm’s Lord is in Lagna, the native will be fortunate, will be honoured by the king, be virtuous, charming, learned and honoured by the public.

99. If Dharm’s Lord is in Sahaj Bhava, the native will be endowed with fraternal bliss, be wealthy, virtuous and charming.
